info.name: Car Rental CRM API — Location Marrakech
info.description:
Complete REST API surface for the Marrakech car-rental CRM. Auth: POST login returns a Sanctum token that a test script stores into the collection variable `token`. Every other request reads it automatically. Default demo data is pre-seeded (cars 1-4, clients 1-3, extras 1-4, roles 1=admin / 2=manager / 3=agent / 4=finance).

Login: admin@location.ma / password (full permissions).

Flow to try first: login → list cars → create a client → create a reservation → confirm → activate → add payment → complete.
